name: Noun
description: A word that represents a person, place, thing, or idea

name: Verb
description: A word that expresses an action, occurrence, or state of being

name: Adjective
description: A word that describes or modifies a noun

name: Adverb
description: A word that modifies a verb, adjective, or other adverb

name: Preposition
description: A word that shows the relationship between a noun and other words in a sentence

name: Conjunction
description: A word that connects words, phrases, or clauses

name: Interjection
description: A word that expresses strong emotion

name: Pronoun
description: A word that replaces a noun
